description: Source code for managing gateway authentication configuration, including merging configs, resolving secrets, and ensuring startup authentication in an OpenClaw environment.

methods.name: mergeGatewayAuthConfig
methods.description: Merges two GatewayAuthConfig objects, with override taking precedence.

methods.name: mergeGatewayTailscaleConfig
methods.description: Merges two GatewayTailscaleConfig objects, with override taking precedence.

methods.name: resolveGatewayAuthFromConfig
methods.description: Resolves the gateway authentication based on configuration and overrides.

methods.name: shouldPersistGeneratedToken
methods.description: Determines if a generated token should be persisted based on override and mode source.

methods.name: hasGatewayTokenCandidate
methods.description: Checks if a gateway token is available via environment, override, or secrets.

methods.name: hasGatewayTokenOverrideCandidate
methods.description: Checks if a token override candidate exists.

methods.name: hasGatewayPasswordOverrideCandidate
methods.description: Checks if a password override candidate exists.

methods.name: shouldResolveGatewayTokenSecretRef
methods.description: Determines if the gateway token secret reference should be resolved.

methods.name: resolveGatewayTokenSecretRef
methods.description: Resolves the gateway token secret reference asynchronously.

methods.name: shouldResolveGatewayPasswordSecretRef
methods.description: Determines if the gateway password secret reference should be resolved.

methods.name: resolveGatewayPasswordSecretRef
methods.description: Resolves the gateway password secret reference asynchronously.

methods.name: ensureGatewayStartupAuth
methods.description: Ensures the gateway startup authentication is properly configured, generating tokens if needed.

methods.name: assertHooksTokenSeparateFromGatewayAuth
methods.description: Checks that hooks token does not match gateway auth token if both are configured.
